textCellHeights.text: Activity Score combines CPU usage and idle wakeups. Higher scores indicate greater process activity, not measured power consumption. Bars use a fixed 0–100 scale; › marks scores above 100. CPU 100% means one logical core.

limitations: Process energy, battery telemetry, history, and Settings privileged dependencies are deterministic fixtures. No sampling correctness or physical-hardware power-mode assertion is inferred from screenshots.
method: WindowServer capture of default-three production TopProcessesView in two owned Classic fixture windows, light and dark, with an owned underlay in a disposable ARM GUI VM.
